reviews.text: [h2]游戏概述[/h2] 《晶灵小队》是一款萌系画风的类幸存者游戏，你将带领元素生物「晶灵」们迎接蜂拥而至的「失魂者」，捍卫你们的家园。作为一款萌宠类肉鸽弹幕游戏，你可以挑战8张场景精美和带有独特场地效果的地图，与超190种失魂者战斗，共有超20种可操控晶灵，90种可自由搭配的遗物，构筑属于你的专属玩法！ [h2]主要剧情[/h2] 灾难降临，无数的晶灵丧失自由，沦为凶残的失魂者。四散的晶灵们决定加入由你组建的一支名为「晶灵小队」的队伍，与你一同战胜失魂者，夺回属于我们的家园。 [h2]玩法[/h2] 本作共有超20种可操控晶灵，初始仅有5种，其余晶灵将在完成对应解救任务/成就后解锁。不同的晶灵有不同的属性和连携属性，当队伍里存在多个能打出连携作用的晶灵时，队伍战斗力将突飞猛进。 开局可选择一种晶灵进入战斗，在击败BOSS后可在随机三个已解锁晶灵中选择一个加入队伍。初始晶灵和伙伴晶灵能够使用的技能存在差异，不过打出的连携反应没有区别。在晶灵升级后可以随机抽取多项属性选择其中一个进行升级，其中也包括了晶灵技能等级。初始晶灵可选择伤害、攻击范围、冷却三个方向进行升级，最高十级；伙伴精灵最高升至五级。 在局外玩家可自由搭配遗物，最多可同时装备两种遗物。遗物可通过完成成就解锁，每个遗物首次被携带可获得「比克西」（也就是金币）奖励。如果你觉得关卡难度过高，可尝试携带遗物「牛奶咖啡」来降低难度。 每个地图都有独有的动态场景（例如下雨），同时存在各种特色的地图陷阱（例如雷击）。每个地图存在多个BOSS，击败BOSS后可随机在三位晶灵种邀请一位加入队伍成为伙伴晶灵，或者获得回复血量的道具。每个关卡都会随机触发特殊事件，包括了击杀事件、收集事件等多种事件，完成特殊事件将获得强力奖励。 [h2]总结[/h2] 一款可玩性较高的萌系类幸存者游戏，属性/队伍成型后会玩得很爽，推荐喜欢萌宠或者对类幸存者玩法感兴趣的玩家。 [quote] 闲暇时光，不妨试试游戏。 欢迎关注[url=store.steampowered.com/curator/45653622/] 闲暇時光鉴赏组 [/url] [/quote]

I have mixed feelings with this game. The idea is great, but there is nothing exciting there besides the Pokemon-like twist. Gameplay is dull, on level ups you have to max damage on your main skill, otherwise you will get easily swarmed by enemies. It seems there is no space for creativity or crazy combos like in other similar games. You max damage up just to be able to kill next wave of enemies, and sometimes if there is no other choice, you should pick one or two points in hp regen and movement speed, that's all. Enemies get bulkier with each wave and simply walk towards you, bosses may have more interesting attack patterns but they are still meh. Shards type doesn't seem to matter here, it is only a visual effect for your powers (NPCs will only walk). Summon-able creatures are just additional skills, you can improve them on some level ups, but not in a specific way to create builds, only an overall improvement. Maybe I have misjudged it and it is a game for kids (nothing wrong with that), but why is it so difficult then? Enemies have a lot of hp and the dash has a long cooldown. You can't run aimlessly on a normal difficulty. I'm sure the better combos and more effective/fun skills can be found later, but I'm not willing to wait 5h to find something that I can get at the beginning in other games. If you are looking for a game for your kid - this one is cheap and may be fun for some time but I think there are better choices. If you are an adult player and came here only because you are a Vampire Survivors and/or Pokemon fan - there are for sure better choices.

数值成长太低，后期乏力，最低难度的第7张地图，游玩的一半时间不是割草，而是躲弹幕小游戏，精灵的羁绊不知道是数值太低还是什么，都不如你多升两级的数值体感来的快，一把2000金币只够升1级中期，局外成长数值过于保守，想肉鸽割草和后期爽打的玩家不建议入坑，而且所谓的羁绊你以为和云顶之翼一样有质变，很可惜即使羁绊胡了你没有变强多少从击杀效率就可以直观感受. 耗时7小时难度1通关了，通关的要点就是先点满回血和移速，极致的刮痧特别是最终BOSS，除了前两张图难度算平衡，后面都是刮痧，没有回血就很容易寄，我都怀疑我玩的平面弹幕游戏，未来可期吧
闪避距离和作者一样短小，一个杂兵的身位都没有可以当作是没有，羁绊效果基本等于无，没有幸存者类的割草爽感，全程躲弹幕，极致的刮痧，最有用的技能居然是回血和加防御，因为刮痧和杂兵的封锁你必须硬抗伤害，角色22个 实际等于无，无论你选哪个都一样，不推荐购买
伤害太低了，局外养成数值给的他妈的少的一批，我全部升满了，进去还是刮痧，宠物羁绊跟他妈没有一样，伤害低，频率慢，闪避距离短也就算了，他妈的CD还长，一直在躲小怪，傻逼游戏。

Do not be fooled by the game's "family friendly" presentation or the first level's overall design. Level 2 is where the pain begins, and level 3 escalates it to a point that made me just ragequit. I assumed this game would be a Bullet Heaven, whose purpose is to make me feel like a god. In truth, it's a Bullet Hell. Enemies that - even with metaprogression perks - nearly outrun you, come at you from strange angles, oscillate around you, shoot you with projectiles, rush at you, ... all at once. It's overwhelming and stressing.
做得太好了！very good!

This is a pokemon-like bullet hell game, with lots of characters, levels, abilities and upgrades. When you first start the game you have two different modes to choose from. The first is Apprentice, which is a more relaxed experience with faster progression. The other is Explorer, which according to the game is the intended way, with balanced rewards and battles. I chose Apprentice, just so I wouldnt have to play this game forever. You have these cute animal creatures. They are essentially your heroes. You start on this little floating island, and this serves as your town. From here you can switch characters, equip unlocked relics, craft recipes and start the different levels. When you start a level, it is a lot like in any other bullet hell game. You run around, collecting shards from dead enemies so you can level up and pick from a selection of basic upgrades. The basic upgrades are all passive buffs, but there are also different special upgrades. There is one that allows you to pick one of your other characters to pop in to battle and do a special attack. You will get this multiple times throughout a run, so you have a little army with you by the end of the level. Every character runs on a cooldown and will automatically spawn in when ready. Then there is this other special ability thing that spawns from mandatory events. Mandatory events are as the name suggests, events that you have to complete and if you fail makes you lose. They can however unlock various different things, like crazy time limited buffs, instant level up, instantly collect every gem on the map and so on. This is one of the better bullet hell games I have played and it is priced generously in my opinion. This game also has local co-op mode, but I havent tried that yet. I definitely recommend this. _________________________________ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45534557/]Help me out by following my Curator, I’d really appreciate it!![/url]

一款挺不错的类幸存者游戏，用晶灵小队替代了武器升级系统，前期略肝，角色全解锁后才算正式开始，游戏整体难度不算大，不过目前内容比较少，遗物很多但是每局只能带两个进地图，并且队伍系统的新颖在游戏中没有完全体现出来，队伍羁绊系统激活奖励感觉可有可无没有太大区别，整局下来输出基本全靠玩家本体角色，流派体系整体优势不明显以及支援角色cd过长的劣势导致游戏里升级加点几乎全看主要角色，整体上没有肉鸽游戏的爽感，不过还是值得一玩，先观望期待作者后续更新。
远程怪比近战怪还多，你觉得我买个幸存者游戏是想来玩东方的吗
花了6小时玩通关了。能让我玩下去的动力其中之一就是角色可爱的风格。玩起来都比较轻松舒服和不错的体验。 游戏中一大特色就是打赢一个精英怪就可以让一只晶灵加入队伍，协助支援。有一种找伙伴的感觉。打架人多就是正义。 各种晶灵数值这一块还是相当紧凑的，没有数值膨胀，也没有难到头皮发麻的那种不合理。控制得比较恰当。而且每个晶灵攻击和协助方式都不一样。玩法多样性，还有羁绊加成。总体体验来说，值得一玩。

比较喜欢这游戏的美术风格，但你们的玩法拖了后腿，作为半个策划我看不下去了，看你们对中文玩家友好，免费提供简单的建议： 1、进化角色形态（超级武器），请注意需要有质变，在进化后才能为玩家提供足够的满足感——来自吸血鬼幸存者的成功经验。 2、羁绊要改进的话工作量较大，只说遗物——遗物系统没发挥出潜力，浪费了设计的那么多遗物，作为roguelike应该增加在每局过程中能拥有的遗物数量，除了开局自选的两个以外，在增加小队同伴时应该同时获得两件遗物（4选2），这样在每局后期能拥有2+10总共12件遗物，能大大提高游玩过程的正反馈以及变化的花样——来自土豆兄弟的成功经验。 3、降低普通敌人的生命值，提高普通敌人的数量，让除了boss以外的敌人子弹能被摧毁或者射程缩短到屏幕内，但程序要优化（这游戏移动有点莫名卡顿）。街机游戏已经没落，大量的类幸存者玩家最需要的其实是用自己的弹幕消灭海量敌人的爽快，不是来打石头和躲避屏幕外子弹的，尤其还混杂敌我双方单位和技能的干扰。 4、加强敌我单位和技能的颜色区别，不该太让人眼花，土豆兄弟这方面就做得好，而吸血鬼幸存者虽然眼花，但由于能摧毁敌人和子弹，因此减轻了问题。 5、请一个数值策划？你抄同行都比现在好。还有局外成长数值，有的1%这么搞笑干什么（热门同类大多数是你的5倍），大部分局外成长数值翻倍还差不多，属性伤害方面5倍，生命恢复和护甲不用再提高。
画风好评，游戏性一般，没有肉鸽游戏的那种成长的快感。一局游戏，初期到后期，就没有爽的时候，全程挨打。好不容易局外成长也点高了，还是挨打。明明饰品有那么多，结果就开放了俩个栏位，对战斗助力极其有限。如果你喜欢游戏画风你可以入手，如果你想要土豆兄弟那种割草快感，不建议入手。
防御技能太缺了，搞得选什么输出技能都差不多，被怪碰几下死，加那一点点生命防御移速，没有机制类的防御技能

第一次玩这么无聊的幸存者，进游戏，刮痧，走位，这很正常，但你妹的我玩了20分钟了还是在刮痧走位是什么意思，技能强化也都是数值类型，装模作样搞个羁绊系统，才几个怪啊，能激活几个羁绊啊，又不是自走棋。一进下个地图一定是被数值碾压的，还得刷一刷局外成长，一大堆局外数值强化，看的我想吐。打到第四张图，玩家，怪物，玩家特效，怪物特效混在一起，糊成一团，吸血鬼幸存者里面，怪物会覆盖玩家特效，我好歹能看见有怪近身了。玩家的技能少也是一点，可玩性太低了
怪物血量还是太少了，怪物移速还是太慢了，角色性能还是太强了，地图还是过于大了，局外成长给的数值还是太高了👎👎👎👎👎👎👎

This game is difficult on Hard mode but not because it's challenging, it's because the upgrades are ♥♥♥♥ and the game expects you to have a full upgrade tree to even attempt Hard mode and it requires insane grinding to unlock it, and even after unlocking it provides a very very very modest boost, the same as upgrades during the run. 2/3 of the characters are complete unplayable crap. Their mechanics don't scale (for example, poison, no matter how much and what you level up, it always deal 20 damage, which is a joke when enemies have thousands, and I'm not even talking about bosses). The whole "get other pets during the run" mechanic is also weak, badly designed. There are no synergies, no evolutions, no real builds, every run with the same character is always the same. It's a good quality bad game.
没有明确特色，局外成长满了也大提升，到后期都不能爽，加速也没有，特别是最后一个成就要50万金币更是纯恶心

It's unfortunate that I can't recommend this game - It could be an awesome bullet heaven game, but in the current iteration I don't think so...still needs a lot of work. Pros: - Art style is great. - The shards (characters) are awesome designs. - Synergies that activate immediately based on the shards in your party are cool. Cons: - Permanent upgrades are horrible. Instead of general damage, you have to upgrade each elements damage. You get 1% crit per upgrade, while the crit item during a run gives 5% crit per stack. There's no upgrade to gain more of the progression currency either, so it's extremely grind-y. A 20 minute run might only yield me 2000 coins, which is enough for 1 upgrade in the mid-tier. The upgrades feel absolutely awful. - There is no way to banish a terrible item (at least in the amount of time I spent playing, I didn't find it) - The items you find during a run also feel horrible. Your character seems to max out at 10 upgrades, significantly limiting your strength and you have to rely on supportive characters found via mini-boss fights. There is no general damage upgrade. There is no XP upgrade. There is no progressive currency upgrade. I think that some of these must be design choices to separate the game from the pack, but the design choices are moving in the wrong direction. The upgrades that I mentioned in this review are general to the genre and integral to making it feel like you're reducing the grind and making each run more exciting and feeling the strength of your characters continue to build over time. Simply uncapping your main character and offering more than 10 upgrades & implementing the general upgrades that I mentioned would make this game much more enjoyable. I hope someday I can come pack and change my review if I find out those things have been changed.
熊熊指挥官好色哦齁齁齁齁我要开吃啦

是我玩过的最无聊的幸存者，没有furry的话早退款了。 第一二关你要打的全是换皮小龙虾，然后第三关开始来了点阴间玩意，你就开始了刮痧旅程，可能是我加点有问题，第三关关底boss我刮了10分钟，打完整个人都燃尽了。 你用一个武器从头打到尾，升级加的全是数值，你思考的主要选择基本上就是这个点我加攻击还是冷却，那个点我加移速还是减伤，一局20-30分钟内的内容你在第一分钟就体验过了，后面就是弹幕多点。 还有它核心的伙伴机制，你选的伙伴等于你周期性释放的技能，绝大部分作用是帮你补点伤害，然后打完一看数据，输出只有你平a的几成。连携技的总伤更是和你差了一个数量级，而且附加的连携特效好像不会随等级效果增强，有些连携还送点有意思的小玩意比如眩晕的跟班或者小aoe，但是这些玩意用处不大，最重要的是不会带来玩法上的任何改变，没法说玩一个流派，加一些点把依靠平a输出完全改成依靠小弟或者特效输出，头几分钟你边平a边转来转去，后期你有了这些小玩意照样边平a边转来转去。 他做了特别多的英雄，做了一堆属性伤害但打在敌人身上的效果根本没有区别，属性伤害至少得来点特效吧，燃烧挂dot，水系挂减速，这些都是用烂了的设定，但是他就没有，也没有替代这个的机制。依我看不如缩减英雄数量，把一些英雄的技能或者攻击方式做成技能树，让玩家中途可以选择流派比如近战转成远程之类的，平a转成召唤物；升级也别嗯加平a伤害平a冷却平a范围，你可以升级特效伤害，升级召唤物，升级特定属性的伤害针对不同抗性的敌人；你说这样就和别的幸存者没有任何区别了，关键是这个游戏的机制相比烂大街幸存者的机制来说没有开辟一条什么值得去的领域的道路，他反而压缩了玩家的决策空间，要我看作者还不如想想怎么把他想做的连携特点融入到经典的机制里面去。
推荐，挺好玩的，价格非常实惠，关卡类型的类幸存者玩法游戏，有羁绊系统，局外成长，可操控的角色挺多的，内容不算少。
小巧精致的游戏，就是玩法深度还需要再挖掘挖掘，目前看来爽度还是差点意思，不过胜在便宜，当做一个不大不小的幸存者like打发时间也是很足够的
远程怪物太多，没有割草的爽感
我的评价是这款游戏作为一款割草类游戏无疑是非常失败的，首先爽度几乎为零所有强化都是数值角色多但都是套公式完全没有创新，局外强化更是一坨，全是数值强化给的还特别少升级还特别困难，游戏难度特别高，小怪又肉又多还几乎全是远程，BOSS特别多，据我观察都是玩家操纵角色的强化版非常烦人，最新更新的棱彩球我已为会有心意，结果还是数值，给的还是特别低。总的来说这游戏很垃圾，千万别买，千万别买。
· 画面像素风吸引人，初上手十分美妙，各种角色和技能。 · 不到五把进入疲惫期，怪物全是远程很难躲，后期还是爽不起来纯粹挨打，装模作样的羁绊系统其实叠不了两三层，极其稀疏的事件玩得打瞌睡。

Shard squad is a bit of a hidden gem in a sea of survivorslike. While it doesn’t bring about any genre breaking ideas, there’s enough passion and difficulty here for anyone familiar with the “one more run” itch. The art style is cozy, and there are plenty of unlocks and party combinations to experiment with as you complete quests. Some of the harder levels are even reminiscent of being thrown into a Touhou stage which in my opinion is a fun time! There is a co-op mode but my playtime has been completely solo. The initial gameplay hook got me to finish the main story which is relatively light in itself but the theme is enjoyable nonetheless. Now I’m in the post game to tackle the more difficult content and I’m looking forward to see what’s in store. The devs also seem keen on continuing development, so soon enough there will be more to dive into. All in all if you’re a fan of survivorslike this title is worth a shot in its own right.

[h1][b]超萌小队齐出击[/b][/h1] 《晶灵小队》是一款非常可爱的类幸存者游戏，玩家将进入一个如梦似幻的像素世界，带领萌萌的晶灵对抗怪物侵袭。 游戏的基础模式和《吸血鬼幸存者》类似，也是在一张大地图上迎战层出不穷的敌人，杀敌后捡取经验值，升级并进行构筑。 不同的是，本作的角色们只专注于一种能力，比如初始的小浣熊就非常擅长喷火，升级项目也是增加伤害、技能范围、冷却缩减、移动速度之类的，因此玩家无需纠结技能搭配，专心发育就完事了。 随着流程推进，会有Boss出现，击败后可以获得新的小队成员，这些角色的加入有效的弥补了技能单一的问题。 角色共分为5个大类，分别是火系、雷电系、水系、自然系、水晶系，单个出现的话并不起眼，但组合到一起便会带来质变效果，到了中后期满屏都是技能特效，普通敌人根本无法近身，非常的爽快。 除此之外，游戏还在流程中加入了一些随机事件，比如灌篮、收集花朵、击败特定区域的敌人、解救晶灵等。 游戏打造了多张地图可供选择，其会随着不断游玩持续解锁。 此类游戏必备的局外成长内容自然也没有落下，使用局内获得的金币便可以进行升级，因此越往后体验也更加顺畅，如果觉得难度过高，也有学徒难度可以选择。 整体表现挺不错的一款游戏，晶灵的存在很有宝可梦的感觉，多晶灵组成队伍一起作战，无论视觉表现还是割草体验都可圈可点。 [quote]热爱游戏，畅玩游戏，分享游戏，专注鉴赏评测与深度解析 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44110339/]游理游据[/url]，走进游戏世界，品味第九艺术[/quote]

While grinding for resources for meta progression. Completion takes around 25h, the game has no missable achievements. [b]Achievement overview[/b] [b]Approximate time to 100%:[/b] Around 25 hours [b]Estimated achievement difficulty:[/b] 3/10 [b]Minimum number of playthroughs needed:[/b] It is a roguelite; you'll play all the stages several times [b]Is there a good guide available:[/b] Yes, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3687058585]here is a guide[/url] for unlocking all the relics, and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3604954518]this guide[/url] will explain how to unlock the last character after beating the game. [b]Multiplayer achievements:[/b] No [b]Missable achievements:[/b] No [b]Grinding achievements:[/b] Yes, to unlock all the relics, you have to spend over 50,000 coins on recipes; this is a huge grind. [b]DLC-only achievements:[/b] No [b]Speedrun achievements:[/b] No [b]Time-gated achievements:[/b] No [b]RNG achievements:[/b] No [b]Does difficulty affect achievements:[/b] No [b]Unobtainable/glitched achievements:[/b] No [b]Gamepad or mouse and keyboard:[/b] I preferred to play with a controller [b]About the game[/b] In Shard Squad, you play as a character who tries to find his missing friends. However, the story isn't the main focus; this game is all about the Bullet Heaven gameplay. In some way, it is your typical Bullet Heaven, where you start off weak and unlock resources with each run to get stronger. However, there are quite a few things that make this game unique. In each level, you not only have the hordes of enemies to kill and bosses that will spawn and you need to defeat, but there are also orbs. If you kill those, you get an upgrade for that run, and there are challenges. In each level, you will find a few different challenges. Those pop up during the run and will tell you how to complete them at that moment. What I love about Shard Squad is how you unlock new characters and relics. You have to do something special to unlock each of them, and it was quite addictive to try and combine as much as possible to unlock a bunch of stuff each run. You can unlock them one by one if you don't want to bother trying to find the combos to unlock a bunch; however, for me, that is where the fun was, figuring out how to unlock multiple at the same time. The only downside I found in Shard Squad is that the screen can get quite busy with all the different attacks. And with how colorful the screens are, and with your team members and enemies being very colorful, it can be an overload of info. However, there are options in the menu to add more transparency to your team members and their effects. [b]About the achievements[/b] None of the achievements are missable. Most of the achievements are for unlocking each character. And a bunch of others are for having a full team + a specific relic equipped to get the maximum bonus in a specific type, for example, the fire trait or the Magical Girls trait. There are also achievements for just unlocking everything, all the stories, all the characters, and all the relics. The one where you have to spend 50k coins on recipes will take quite a while to grind. So choose many "chest" rewards while playing through the levels, which give you 500 coins. [b]Final thoughts[/b] I enjoyed Shard Squad a lot! As stated above, I loved figuring out ways to unlock a bunch of stuff in the same run. Trying to optimize a run. Which sometimes failed, but most of the time worked out in my favor. [b]I give Shard Squad 4 out of 5 stars[/b]. [code]Do you enjoy games that don't have missable achievements? Very fun "survive the hordes/beat the bosses" game with a variety of levels and an awesome final boss stage. ===== THE GOOD ===== - Cute cast of characters with a unique attack. 2 equip slots and permanent stat upgrades. - Unlocks come at a good pace. Fun to obtain the whole roster and give each character a spin. - Sometimes get to feel virtually unstoppable near the end of a round. Satisfying to win a round and get points to purchase stat upgrades. - Music is catchy, especially the menu. Despite everything being cutesy, the final boss music is this crazy intense metal track lol. - Has lore/story to follow. The ending and the scenes shown while the credits roll are adorable and uplifting. ===== THE MEH ===== - A bit unbalanced. Some characters are much better to use than others. For example I found the Water guys to be really weak while the Crystal ones were super strong. - Rough start. I needed to play at the ★Apprentice difficulty until a few permanent upgrades were unlocked. But after that, the default ★★Explorer option was manageable. - Stages take around 15 minutes to complete, which is kinda long and there's a LOT flying around on screen during the last few minutes. Good idea to follow the "take frequent breaks" suggestion. The final boss stage takes about 11 minutes. ===== FINAL THOUGHTS ===== What a blast. As of June 2026 I played for 30+ hours. I'd say it takes around 20-30 hours to complete the story and snag 100% achievements. Also it looks like there's new content coming soon like the evolutions. Awesome!

This is one of the more refreshing takes on the bullet heaven genre. If youre familiar with Vampire Survivor or other games in this genre, you'll know what youre getting into. However, Shard Squad stands out with a few nice mechanics. The game allows you to toggle the auto aim allowing for more precise and intentful attacks. Something I wish VS uses. For creature collecter fans, there's a nice spread of characters with unique attacks and assigned traits which allow for fun team comps if you utilize the traits fully. There's fun little mini games mid missions such as basketball, surfing, and new objectives. Lastly, the newly introduced evolution system really makes the characters shine and firmly places this game as one of the better and unique bullet heaven games.

It's not bad, the idea is really fun but I feel like the execution of the gameplay is done in a really boring way. It also feels like it's much more of a bullet hell than it is a bullet heaven. The further you get through the stages, the more projectiles you have to dodge and the more enemies with different abilities and movement patterns you have to move around. You play as a creature with a base ability, and once you reach max level you evolve and get an extra ability, and/or your base one changes to be more powerful. You get other creatures as supports during your runs, and there's some synergies between different creature types that activate passive abilities. Nothing felt particularly run changing or build enabling to be honest. Some of the damage passives feel very underwhelming compared to others. For example poison stacks up very quickly and ticks for 200 damage each time, but the rain cloud ability did like 50 damage per tick. It feels like either poison's way too strong or the other ones need a bit of a balance pass to make them more interesting options to go for. There's a lot of relics that will either make you stronger or impact the way you'll play during your run. It's a fun idea, but ultimately I ended up going with reduced cooldown almost every single run because you need so much damage in the later stages, and even more so if you increase the difficulty on top. The difficulty curve of the game feels fine on normal difficulty as you progress through the stages, but when you crease the difficulty level itself, I didn't notice much changing besides more enemies with increased health and they do more damage to you. Except you don't really have great ways to scale your own damage up, and there aren't really any crazy creature/ability combinations that will make you pop off. Another thing I disliked is that you reach full power toward the end of your run. You barely get to play for a quarter of your run at full strength, and there's no way to keep going once you beat the stage's final boss, so you have to start a new run and be weak again. It leads to most of your time spent playing the game feeling kinda weak, until you unlock the damage increase relics, or the cooldown reduction ones. The meta upgrades don't feel very interesting either. It's modest numerical increases for pretty much all of them; they aren't game changing and cost so much gold that you don't actually notice much of an increase from one run to another, because of how few levels you can buy between runs. I thought for a good while on giving this a positive or negative review, but ultimately I have to go with negative. I really like the ideas here, but the gameplay felt stale very quickly and the progression was so uninteresting that the game just cannot compete with other titles in the genre in its current state. I understand that the aim was to allow for more strategy during runs, but what actually ends up happening is every run feels more or less the same, and you're just running away from things the entire time until the timer runs out. You hardly ever feel like you have actually gotten powerful, or made a crazy combo that feels like you're getting away with something. And when you do get something really good, you enjoy it for a few minutes and the run's over because you can't achieve it until only a few minutes are left in the run. Took 35 hours to 100%. I think it's got a lot of potential, but it just falls flat overall in my opinion.
